Aggregation results

500 dilemmas · four selection rules over normalised scores · credences: equal (1/3 each). Ties are shown as sets; a rule with several ids was indifferent between them.

Two levels of agreement. Same response asks whether some single response could satisfy all four rules. Same recommendation is weaker: rules may pick different responses and still endorse the same course of action. Rules disagree at the recommendation level whenever one selects a label (TO_DO / NOT_TO_DO / REFUSAL / OTHER) that another cannot.
